item.text:
**Bottom Line**
Mixed. In 2024, Abiy Ahmed’s government clearly corrected course in macroeconomic policy and, late in the year, in the Somalia dispute. But in domestic security, the public record looks much less adaptive: instead of visibly replacing ineffective implementers, the state leaned on emergency powers, secret coercive structures, and crackdowns on scrutiny.

**Evidence For Adaptation**
- Title: `IMF Executive Board Completes the First Review under the Extended Credit Facility (ECF) Arrangement for Ethiopia` | Publisher: IMF | Date: 2024-10-18 | URL: https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/10/18/pr-24383-ethiopia-imf-completes-the-1st-review-under-the-ecf-arrangement | Claim: The IMF said Ethiopia met all quantitative performance criteria and most structural benchmarks, and that the exchange-rate transition was advancing with limited disruption. This is strong evidence of policy correction after macroeconomic stress. | QIDs: 8B.8
- Title: `The National Bank of Ethiopia announces the launch of a new monetary policy framework` | Publisher: National Bank of Ethiopia | Date: 2024-07-09 | URL: https://nbe.gov.et/nbe_news/the-national-bank-of-ethiopia-announces-the-launch-of-a-new-monetary-policy-framework/ | Claim: The central bank shifted to an interest-rate-based, price-stability framework and expanded operating tools. This supports a reading that Abiy’s team changed methods rather than just defending the old one. | QIDs: 8B.8
- Title: `Ethiopia's PM defends currency float amid inflation concerns` | Publisher: Reuters | Date: 2024-08-02 | URL: https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Ethiopia-s-PM-defends-currency-float-amid-inflation-concerns-47541564/ | Claim: Abiy defended the birr float as a move to close the official-black-market gap, and authorities then used price enforcement after the shock. This is evidence of tactical adjustment after an initial policy shock. | QIDs: 8B.8
- Title: `Ankara Declaration` / `Ethiopia and Somalia agree to respect sovereignty and cooperate` | Publisher: Republic of Türkiye Ministry of Foreign Affairs | Date: 2024-12-12 | URL: https://www.mfa.gov.tr/etiyopya-federal-demokratik-cumhuriyeti-ve-somali-federal-cumhuriyeti-nin-ankara-bildirisi.en.mfa | Claim: Ethiopia and Somalia reaffirmed sovereignty, set aside disputes, and committed to cooperation. That is late-year de-escalation after a risky early-year maritime tactic. | QIDs: 8B.8

**Evidence Against Adaptation**
- Title: `In Ethiopia, a secret committee orders killings and arrests to crush rebels` | Publisher: Reuters | Date: 2024-02-23 | URL: https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/ethiopia-secret-committee-orders-killings-arrests-crush-rebels-2024-02-23/ | Claim: Reuters reported a secret security committee in Oromia ordering extrajudicial killings and illegal detentions, and said it was formed soon after Abiy took office. This points to hidden coercive governance, not visible correction by replacing bad implementers. | QIDs: 8B.8
- Title: `Ethiopia: Authorities Suspend Three Rights Groups` | Publisher: Human Rights Watch | Date: 2024-12-02 | URL: https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/12/02/ethiopia-authorities-suspend-three-rights-groups | Claim: The government suspended three human-rights organizations after they criticized proposed media-law changes, while Abiy publicly praised reform rhetoric. That looks like suppression of scrutiny rather than corrective reform. | QIDs: 8B.8
- Title: `Ethiopia rejects allegations its forces massacred civilians as the West urges an investigation` | Publisher: Associated Press | Date: 2024-02-15 | URL: https://apnews.com/article/ethiopia-troops-violence-fano-amhara-ba26d3c99bd03378ead8b65732814c96 | Claim: Officials denied massacre allegations in Merawi even as rights groups and Western governments called for an investigation. The response reads as denial, not accountability or course correction. | QIDs: 8B.8
- Title: `Landlocked Ethiopia signs pact to use Somaliland's Red Sea port` | Publisher: Reuters | Date: 2024-01-01 | URL: https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Landlocked-Ethiopia-signs-pact-to-use-Somaliland-s-Red-Sea-port-45654814/ | Claim: The Berbera deal tied port access to possible naval use and political concessions, which escalated Horn tensions. This is evidence of a risky tactic that initially intensified the problem rather than correcting it. | QIDs: 8B.8

**Search Gap**
I did not find reliable public evidence that Abiy publicly removed ineffective security commanders or other domestic coercive implementers because their tactics failed. The public record instead shows two patterns: technocratic correction in the economic file, and coercive consolidation in the security file.
